text:
Jen: Quick question — what's one tiny, maybe weird, thing that instantly makes your day better? Non-work stuff only!

Ravi: Finding a sticky note with a doodle I forgot I left for myself. Instant grin. :grin: 

Claire: Putting on the 30-sec chorus of a song that makes me dance even if it's 9am. No shame. :musical_note:

Nina: Successfully untangling headphones on the first try. So rare, feels like a tiny victory. :headphones:

Kevin: Watching my cat attempt a majestic jump and fail in the cutest way. I have a 7-sec clip for emergencies. :cat: (saved in "tiny-wins")

Jen: @Kevin drop the clip pls, morning meetings need moral boosts :raised_hands:

Kevin: https://example.com/fails/cat-leap.gif (highly scientific mood booster)

Louis: Spritzing a citrus room spray. Smells like clean, immediate optimism. :lemon:

Claire: Finding a single piece of gum in my bag that I thought I ran out of — madness, pure joy. :laughing:

Nina: Also, folding a towel so the corners line up. Weirdly soothing. :sparkles:

ops-bot: Reminder posted: "Water the office succulents" (thanks Louis). :seedling:

Jen: These are great. Thinking of starting a #tiny-joys channel so we can drop gifs/links and make a mini library of mood-boosters. Anyone in? :slightly_smiling_face:
